exposure: Risk group (preterm birth risk, term birth risk, control)
cohort: 284 women investigated antepartum and six weeks postpartum, divided into three groups: risk of preterm birth (N = 95), risk of term birth (N = 99), and control group (N = 90).
finding: Trait anxiety and unplanned delivery mode directly and indirectly increased the risk of CB-PTSD symptoms, while planned delivery mode had indirect reducing effects on CB-PTSD symptoms across all groups.
mod_finding: Planned delivery mode indirectly reduced CB-PTSD symptoms, while unplanned delivery mode increased the risk, with the effect being stronger in the preterm birth risk group.
